comment: form controls with appearance: none look as Chromium's html.css styles them, with no theme: a select keeps its 1px solid border and ButtonFace background, without the menu list's inner padding or arrow; buttons and button inputs are html.css's padding: 1px 6px and 2px outset ButtonBorder; a textarea keeps its 1px solid frame; text-like fields (search is border-box) the 2px inset border; a range is a bare box; a progress bar is html.css's grey bar with a green value. Ahem text with line-height: 1 (a select's line-height: normal is measured with the fallback font before Ahem loads, in Chromium).
